serverManagerWithTarget.en: {{folder}} is not visible in Server Manager — use File Explorer for NTFS.
serverManagerWithTarget.tr: {{folder}} klasörü şu an ekranda görünmüyor. NTFS için File Explorer kullanın.

serverManagerGeneric.en: Server Manager shows shares, not NTFS subfolder ACLs.
serverManagerGeneric.tr: Server Manager paylaşımları gösterir; NTFS alt klasör ACL'lerini değil.

targetHiddenWithPath.en: {{folder}} is not visible on screen — navigate first.

targetHiddenNoPath.en: Specify folder path; do not assume selected item is the target.
targetHiddenNoPath.tr: Klasör yolunu belirtin; seçili öğeyi hedef sanmayın.

instruction.en: NTFS subfolder permissions are not set in Server Manager. Open {{path}} in File Explorer.
instruction.tr: NTFS alt klasör izni Server Manager'da verilmez. File Explorer'da {{path}} yoluna gidin.

instruction.en: Type {{path}} in the address bar and press Enter.
instruction.tr: Adres çubuğuna {{path}} yaz ve Enter'a bas.

instruction.en: First type the target folder path in the File Explorer address bar.
instruction.tr: Önce File Explorer'da adres çubuğuna hedef klasör yolunu yaz.

instruction.en: Right-click the {{folder}} folder and choose Properties.
instruction.tr: {{folder}} klasörüne sağ tıkla ve Properties / Özellikler seç.

onCorrectScreen.en: AD Users and Computers is open.

wrongScreen.en: Open AD Users and Computers first.
wrongScreen.tr: Önce AD Users and Computers açın.

instruction.en: Properties > Account > Unlock account, or right-click > Unlock.
instruction.tr: Properties > Account > Unlock account veya sağ tık > Unlock.

instruction.en: Open Active Directory Users and Computers.
instruction.tr: Active Directory Users and Computers açın.

instruction.en: IPv4 > Scope > Reservations > New Reservation. Enter MAC and IP{{ipHint}}.
instruction.tr: IPv4 > Scope > Reservations > New Reservation. MAC ve IP gir{{ipHint}}.

instruction.en: Review scope leases and address pool for conflicts.
instruction.tr: Scope lease ve address pool'da çakışmayı kontrol edin.

instruction.en: Navigate the DHCP tree to the relevant scope or option.
instruction.tr: DHCP ağacında ilgili scope veya seçeneğe gidin.

instruction.en: Select zone > New Host (A/AAAA) or New Pointer (PTR) or MX as needed.
instruction.tr: Zone seç > New Host (A/AAAA) veya New Pointer (PTR) veya MX oluştur.

instruction.en: Navigate to the relevant forward/reverse zone.
Select site or Application Pool and open Bindings or Advanced Settings.
instruction.tr: Site veya Application Pool seç, Bindings veya Advanced Settings aç.

event1074.tr: Event 1074 planlı yeniden başlatma/kapatma anlamına gelir.

instruction.en: Windows Logs > System. Filter Event ID 1074 and review details.
instruction.tr: Windows Logs > System. Event ID 1074 filtrele ve detayları incele.

instruction.en: Select the relevant log and review the selected event.
instruction.tr: İlgili log'u seç ve olayı incele.
